notes: One-string practice is now visibly what it always should have been: a sliding scale up the ENTIRE string - the board lights the whole string, dims the others, and drops the mode box (a new 'Mode box' chip locks it back on if you want position work). And looping practice breathes: add a 1-4 beat rest at the start, end or both sides of each loop, with the click counting you through the gap.
